statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℂ) (s : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)),
  (∑ χ ∈ s, ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), w n * star (χ (n : ZMod m))) /
      (Real.sqrt (m.totient : ℝ) : ℂ)‖^2) ≤
    (1 + (N/m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), ‖w n‖^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0015 · 按整数纤维长度控制任意特征频段的权能量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0015 · Bound character-band energy by the integer fiber length

brief.zh: 先在长度 N+1 的整数窗中逐同余类用 Cauchy–Schwarz，再用单位群 Parseval。显式因子 1+⌊N/m⌋ 允许细层模数超过 N。
brief.en: Apply Cauchy–Schwarz to each residue fiber of the N+1 integers, then use Parseval on the unit group. The factor 1+⌊N/m⌋ also covers a modulus above N.
